200 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management successfully created the bulk operation task.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
string
The UUID of the task.
string
The UUID of the container where the task is operating.
string
Enum: "NEW"
"RUNNING"
"COMPLETED"
"FAILED"
"STALE"
The status of the task. Possible status values are:
NEW —The task was created but has not yet started
running.
RUNNING —The task is in progress.
COMPLETED —The task is done.
FAILED —There was an error completing the task.
STALE —The task has not been updated in a long
time.
string
An informative, human-readable message about the state
of the task.
criteria
items
not_items
task_id
container_uuid
status
message
integer
Start time of the task in unix time milliseconds.
integer
End time of the task in unix time milliseconds, if the task is
finished.
integer
Last time progress was made on executing the task in unix
time milliseconds.
integer
Total amount of work which the task will attempt to
complete.
integer
Total amount of work that the task has completed.
integer
total_work_units_completed  divided by
total_work_units .
— 400 Returned if your request message contained an invalid parameter.
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to create or interact with a bulk operation task.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
— 500 Returned if an error occurred while attempting to create or interact with the bulk operation.
